description: This file contains shell script functions related to preparing UBI devices for OpenWrt installation on Buffalo hardware. It provides functions to attach UBI volumes, remove volumes, create volumes, and update volumes with specific data, specifically tailored to Buffalo device firmware updates.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares UBI devices by removing specific volumes to set up for firmware upgrade.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_optvol
methods.description: Creates necessary UBI volumes and updates them with dummy data for firmware validation.
